edit.description: evaluateInlineExec's spawn — apply win32-ENOENT→shell-retry fallback per §6, mirroring execGate.
export execGate (or equivalent) if Prompt.ts reuses it rather than duplicating the fallback.

summary: evaluateInlineExec hardcodes exec("sh",...) with no win32 fallback; apply execGate's direct-spawn→ENOENT→shell-retry pattern (§6 spawn discipline).

tests.asserts: inline-exec spawn retries through the shell on simulated win32 ENOENT instead of producing <exec-failed>; POSIX path unchanged.

acceptance: inline-exec on win32 (or ENOENT-simulated) retries via shell instead of failing every tick; existing POSIX behavior byte-identical.
notes: Confirmed live: src/Prompt.ts:199 bare execFile("sh",...) is exactly the defect §6 names — win32 bays get <exec-failed> digests every tick, masking real failures downstream. execGate (src/builtinGates.ts:38-54) is the existing precedent. Placeholder→inline-exec quoting is secondary and shell-choice-dependent; verify FLUME_DIR-style paths survive, but full cross-shell syntax portability is out of scope.

edit.description: ShellGateOptions gains env?: Record<string,string>; execGate/shellGate merge it over process.env.

summary: shellGate gains optional env?: Record<string,string> merged over process.env — chains stop hand-forking shellGate to scrub or inject secrets.

tests.asserts: shellGate with env sees the merged var in the spawned command; without env, behavior is byte-identical to today.

acceptance: a shellGate declaring env: { FOO: 'bar' } observes FOO in the spawned process; omitting env is unchanged from current behavior.
notes: Additive optional field, pre-1.0 in-place edit per spec-plan-build.md. Precedent: fenceWhen was added to pendingGate the same way under v0.8 §6 without a new spec section.
